No button anywhere in DOM contains 'Unlock Kite Pro' or any 'Kite Pro' substring. Dashboard, Shop, Leaderboard, Profile all show zero customer-facing 'Kite Pro'. Success-toast copy 'The full sky is open. Thank you for supporting Kite ✨' and already-premium copy 'The full experience is yours. Thank you for supporting Kite 🪁' verified via source (Paywall.jsx L43, L97). No regressions.
